about: OPTIONAL default assumptions you may use, change or ignore. They are not rules and not a required method. Values are plausible for India in 2026 but are hackathon assumptions, not forecasts or advice.

general_inflation_pct_pa.meaning: Yearly rise in everyday living costs.

education_inflation_pct_pa.meaning: Yearly rise in education costs (often assumed higher than general inflation).

post_tax_return_on_payout_pct_pa.meaning: Return the family is assumed to earn, after tax, on an insurance payout invested conservatively. Often used as the discount rate when converting future amounts to today's value.

default_income_growth_pct_pa.meaning: A single income-growth value you can use instead of each profile's own expected_income_growth_pct, if you prefer.

retirement_age.meaning: Age at which earned income is assumed to stop.

self_consumption_share_of_income_pct.meaning: Share of a person's own income that they spend on themselves (and that the family would therefore not need). Commonly deducted in Human Life Value style calculations.

household_expense_share_of_deceased_pct.meaning: Share of monthly household expenses that would stop if the insured person died. Commonly deducted when estimating the family's future expenses.

child_dependency_end_age.meaning: Age until which a child is assumed to be financially dependent.

life_expectancy_age.meaning: Age up to which a dependent spouse or parent may need support, if you choose to model that.

emergency_fund_months.meaning: Months of household expenses to keep as an emergency buffer for the family.

final_expenses_inr.meaning: One-time costs at death (funeral, legal and administrative).

homemaker_services_value_annual_inr.meaning: Yearly cost of replacing a homemaker's unpaid work (childcare, cooking, household management). One possible way to value cover for a person without income.

count_employer_group_cover.meaning: Whether to count employer group life cover as existing cover. Group cover usually lasts only while the person stays with that employer, so some planners count it partly or not at all.

count_retirement_savings_as_available_as.meaning: Whether retirement savings (EPF/PPF/NPS and similar) count as money available to the family. Many planners leave them out.

cover_rounding_inr.meaning: If you want to round a recommended cover, one option is to round up to a multiple of this amount.

benefit_illustration_gross_returns_pct.meaning: Gross investment-return scenarios that IRDAI currently requires insurers to use in benefit illustrations for savings and ULIP products (see docs/glossary.md). Useful for projecting ULIP fund values or participating bonuses; they are not predictions or guarantees.
